description: This file defines a React hook 'useShareMenuItems' that creates a share menu component for dashboards, including options to copy a link, share via email, and embed code, with feature flag checks and Redux state integration.

methods.name: generateUrl
methods.description: Generates a permalink URL for the dashboard, including chart state if applicable.

methods.name: onCopyLink
methods.description: Copies the generated URL to clipboard and shows success or error toast.

methods.name: onShareByEmail
methods.description: Opens mail client with prefilled subject and body containing the dashboard link.
